data.mText: 楽曲ハイスコアレーティング

リハーサル
スタート

wording.dialog_demoPlaySelect_message: 演示模式是可以进行自动演出的功能。\n可以确认谱面及节奏图标的点击等。
wording.dialog_demoPlaySelect_caution: ※演示模式不会显示以及记录分数结果。

spotAtlas.missingSprite: icon_switch: serialized selector reference has no row in this packaged SpotAtlas; NGUI emits no sprite geometry

switchAnimation.midpoint: apply mode UI after first move
switchAnimation.completion: disable tap guard after return to zero

autoLiveAppearance.colorFields: WHITE_ALPHA_1 at static 0x48; BLACK_ALPHA_1 at static 0x78; eligibility and selection choose the latter when OFF

boundaries: Decompiler may join exception tails: use recorded instruction addresses and metadata method bounds.
Account rewards, auto-live allowances and team deck are original account concerns, not simulator input modes.
Editor uses existing live/rehearsal and manual/auto matrix; no new engine mode.

interaction.source: interaction-native.json; method bounds verified against matching dump.cs
interaction.modeState: Formal auto-live selection uses AutoLive cache via 0x32D360C; practice demo uses InGameSettings at 0x124 and its separate cache (0x3A39CC0). Switching the displayed mode must not overwrite the other selection.

header.source: setScreenHeaderName 0x3A38E28 selects wording key by practice flag

mv.switch: changeNext 0x333469C hides previous view, increments modulo view count, shows/applies selected view, then callback
mv.offView: DeckSelectMVSelectorDisableView is a distinct prefab; 0x333194C shows SettingOffView only when MV exists
mv.onView: DeckSelectMVSelectorMVView.updateView 0x3331EC4 sets label to MusicVideoModel display name; not synthetic MV ON/OFF
mv.practice: switchLiveAndPracticeUI hides MV selector in practice; existing runtime recipe excludes practice MV

icons.mv: PreLiveLiveTypeIconsController.getMVIconButtonState 0x3738FA4: an available fully downloaded MV selects State 1. MVIconButton.Initialize 0x3336DC4 enables icon, disables cover and button for State 1. Only pending-download State 2 is interactive.
icons.sp: initializeSPIcon 0x3738E94 activates the GameObject from music special-note availability, independently of MV selection.
icons.layout: Keep prefab icon positions; visibility alone does not repack the row.

editorBoundary: No account availability/attempt limits or team UI
Only uploaded 2D MV is available; 3D cut-in setting is excluded
Uploaded MV uses chart title as its display name because editor media has no original MusicVideoModel title
